reasoning: 驗證目標：$HUModeStatus$ = [SDAR1_SEL] 期間衛星收音模組回報錯誤且無回應時，於衛星音訊模式與 Travel Link 模式皆顯示 Satellite Radio Fault，且在衛星收音模式下持續顯示至相關 DTC 被清除為止。為什麼這樣切：條款有三個判準——訊息、跨兩種模式、持續至 DTC 清除；ER 逐項對應。持續性須以「模式切換後仍在」與「DTC 清除後消失」雙向構造，只驗訊息出現的實作不足以證明其持續條件（§8.4.1）。

tcs.tc_title: Satellite Radio Fault persists across modes until the DTC is cleared
tcs.test_item: If the satellite radio module is reporting an error and is unresponsive while $HUModeStatus$ = [SDAR1_SEL], the HU shall display Satellite Radio Fault whether the active mode is satellite audio mode or Travel Link mode, and the message shall remain in satellite radio mode until the diagnostic trouble code that supports this condition is cleared
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. A SiriusXM signal source is available and the vehicle has an active subscription
2. The HU Satellite Audio source is selected on the Cabin Output Channel
3. The HU is tuned to a receivable Satellite Audio channel
4. $HUModeStatus$ = [SDAR1_SEL]
5. Travel Link mode is available
6. The satellite radio module can be made to report an error and become unresponsive
7. The diagnostic trouble code that supports this condition can be cleared
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Make the satellite radio module report an error and become unresponsive, then read the HU screen in satellite audio mode
2. Change to Travel Link mode and read the HU screen
3. Return to satellite audio mode and read the HU screen
4. Clear the diagnostic trouble code that supports this condition and read the HU screen
tcs.expected_result:
1. Satellite Radio Fault is displayed
2. Satellite Radio Fault is displayed in Travel Link mode
3. Satellite Radio Fault is still displayed, the message having survived both mode changes
4. Satellite Radio Fault is no longer displayed
